items.quote: Rendre Garford headed the talent pipeline for the branch, setting priorities for several teams.
Rendre Garford managed dashboards tracking service performance metrics for their unit.
They handled change management after the merger of two units competently within their team.
Rendre delivered their share of the move of paper-based permit applications to an online portal reliably.
They led an end-to-end review of the service ecosystem across the department.
